profile: one exclusive Worker, scheduler disabled; transient managed locks

replacements.name: %READ-LOCK-RWLOCK-PTR
replacements.effect: recursive read acquisition; conflicting writer refuses

replacements.name: %WRITE-LOCK-RWLOCK-PTR
replacements.effect: recursive write acquisition; readers and other owners refuse

replacements.name: %UNLOCK-RWLOCK-PTR
replacements.effect: release one acquisition with ownership and empty-state checks

replacements.name: %PROMOTE-RWLOCK
replacements.effect: promote exactly one read acquisition; multiple readers refuse
replacements.native_limit: already-writing promotion then unlock times out; no native-equality credit for that branch

replacements.name: %REVIVE-SYSTEM-LOCKS
replacements.obligation: resolve the selected boot consumer and prove absence of native handles or supply managed restoration; this refusal is not closure

replacements.name: %MAKE-SEMAPHORE-PTR
replacements.obligation: scheduler/D5 service before those consumers are admitted

replacements.name: %CSTR-POINTER
replacements.consumer: WITH-CSTRS, level-1/l1-utils.lisp, native database and pointer users
replacements.obligation: replace or exclude each selected native-pointer consumer; no foreign-Wasm-memory claim

replacements.name: MAKE-GCABLE-MACPTR
replacements.consumer: native lock constructors and native %MAKE-GCABLE-PTR in l1-aprims
replacements.obligation: native constructors excluded for Wasm; broader selected consumers still require disposition

note: Ten named proposed boundaries; this manifest does not alter READY replacement accounting or discharge startup dependencies.
